## Contract

What product behavior or research claim changes?

## Threat model and compatibility

What becomes newly accepted, rejected, materialized, or executed? Does any
public API, artifact schema, or frozen protocol change?

## Verification

- [ ] Product and boundary tests pass.
- [ ] Conformance passes.
- [ ] Offline evidence smoke passes when research behavior changes.
- [ ] Wheel and source distribution build and pass archive hygiene.
- [ ] Documentation, changelog, and release record are updated where applicable.
- [ ] No credential, private path, participant record, or unreviewed model output is included.
